TEXT:
I left the maid cafe with Ayase and I once again 
turned to the map for guidance.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Akiba still has a lot of even deeper places, Ayase.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: I-Is that so?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Yeah. According to this map...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Oh! There it is!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Look at this, Ayase. This is the rumored-

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Um, Onii-san?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
According to a certain story, past this alley lies the 
remains of the old Akihabara...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Onii-san, wait up...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Phew, we've been to a lot of places.

This should be enough for a beginner to turn into 
an experienced visitor.

With this, surely Ayase and Kirino's fights are a 
thing of the past.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: ...Hey, Onii-san.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Hm? What is it, Ayase?
I turned my head as Ayase called for me.

Actually, I get the feeling she's been trying to say 
something for a while now.
Is she tired from all this walking?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: I'm sorry, Onii-san.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Eh?

A sudden impact. When I came to, my face could 
feel the cold ground.
...Huh? Why am I...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: I'm truly sorry. I really tried, you know.

The people in the streets sound so far away. Yet 
Ayase's voice is right next to me.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: And yet you won't look at me, Onii-san.

It sounds like she's whispering right next to my ear, 
her voice reverberating inside my head.
I can't hear anything else now.

She looks so sad, yet somehow happy. Ayase's sick 
smile is all that remains in my mind as everything 
fades to black.
